digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-skill integration
propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase must consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` to cite code-health lens trends (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as historical evidence, noting the `unavailable` state for metrics with insufficient accrual

project documentation must expose the `rebar metrics` command surface (the four lens categories, source/confidence labels, unavailable state) and registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative) so contributors and tools can discover and reuse it

examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/discovery.md must instruct agents to invoke `rebar metrics` as a temporal-decay complement to one-shot code-analysis tools and document the unavailable-state caveat
docs/user-guide.md must contain a human-discoverable Metrics section describing the four lenses, source/confidence labeling, and unavailable state, distinct from auto-generated CLI reference
docs/reuse-surface.md must reference the reusable rebar.metrics subsystem (registry and helpers) for library consumers
AGENTS.md must include a metrics pointer in its Where to read list linking to user-guide.md and reuse-surface.md
